name: agent-browser
description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents

scripts.mcp-tools:sync: cd agent-browser && AGENT_BROWSER_UPDATE_MCP_TOOLS=1 cargo test --bin agent-browser mcp_tool_catalog_snapshot
scripts.version: bun run version:sync && git add agent-browser/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:native: bun run version:sync && cargo build --release --manifest-path agent-browser/Cargo.toml && bun scripts/copy-native.ts
scripts.build:linux: bun run version:sync && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm build-linux
scripts.build:macos: bun run version:sync && cargo build --release --manifest-path agent-browser/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-apple-darwin --target x86_64-apple-darwin && cp agent-browser/target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/agent-browser bin/agent-browser-darwin-arm64 && cp agent-browser/target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/agent-browser bin/agent-browser-darwin-x64
scripts.build:windows: bun run version:sync && docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm build-windows
scripts.build:all-platforms: bun run version:sync && bun run --parallel build:linux build:windows && bun run build:macos
scripts.release: bun run version:sync && bun run build:all-platforms && bun publish
scripts.build:source: bun install --frozen-lockfile --filter dashboard && bun run build:dashboard && bun run build:native
